what: `residual_inverse` (`method="auto"`, the default) against fixed-point iteration and against Newton with Woodbury solves, time to tolerance on residual blocks `x + MLP(x)`; `scale` multiplies the readout, so the contraction factor of the fixed-point map grows with it
hardware: one CPU thread of a farm host; one exclusive NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, JAX 0.10.2
protocol: one fresh process per round, three rounds, nine interleaved blocks per cell; ratio = baseline time / auto time per round, geometric mean with the one-sided 95 % t bound of the log ratio over the rounds
